functions.eh: v -> args.next with its value increased by v
functions.eh_context: feed each step to one context, then finish(args.finish)
functions.eh_context_failure: feed each step; the Failure step returns its error; report the accumulated loss

losses.count: non-negative integer; zero = 0; combine = saturating add; total = 18446744073709551615 (u64 max, absorbing)
losses.list: list of strings; zero = []; combine = append; total = [] (NOT absorbing, see spec)

wire: terni serde: {status: success, value} | {status: partial, value, loss} | {status: failure, error, loss}
